opening_line: I’m getting in touch about class expectations.
main_comment: Over the past two weeks, Kai has called out during instructions and has not brought required materials to class on several days. Today we reviewed our start-of-lesson routine and set a simple goal: arrive with notebook and pencil, and wait to be called on. I’ll check in with Kai at the door to support this habit.
closing_line: If it helps, I can share the routine we practiced so you can reinforce it at home.
